title: Dark Optical Trapping of Resonant Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Particles
summary: Mitigating recoil events and minimizing optically induced heating are central challenges in the precise control and cooling of macroscopic particles. To overcome this, we propose trapping resonant dielectric particles for applications in ultra-high vacuum (UHV) levitodynamics. Contrary to other approaches, where suppressing the parasitic resonant scattering was achieved in a standing wave geometry, here we propose a single beam geometry in a dark trap regime.
